assembly.method: Preview base+left using merge-tree, create an unreferenced intermediate commit with those parents, then preview intermediate+right. No branch assembly or lifecycle start.

constraints: Approval pins this manifest SHA-256 independently of the current working tree.
Import source paths with the exact expected modes and blob IDs; do not rewrite them.
Preserve every source head and VREC candidate as an ancestor; do not squash or rebase.
Only integration_only_scope admits new work; old work orders and VRECs keep their exact source bytes.
A changed base, source head or expected import requires a reviewed plan amendment before assembly.
All final archive entries, including new governance and evidence, must remain at or below 10000.
Prior CI success is input evidence only; run final candidate and governance checks independently.

amendment.reason: PR450 establishes the approved work-order delegation on main. Execution must now use that resulting base in a new PR.
amendment.entry_count_meaning: Source imports combined with the seven files already delivered by PR450, before this amendment or later implementation evidence.
